usage: In math, 指數 is the small number written above and to the right of a base, showing repeated multiplication.
It is commonly used with numbers, variables, and powers; you will often hear it in school math and science.
When talking about logarithms, 指數 and base are linked concepts, so it appears in more advanced math too.
For learners, remember 指數 is the math term for exponent, not a general everyday word.
